reason: Instagram already does the job for me and my friend handles it, so I don't see why I'd pay for another place to post flyers. Free listing I might let them do if it costs me nothing, but I'm not paying a monthly fee for it.
objection: How many people actually use this app here? If the crowd isn't on it, it's just one more thing to ignore, and my Instagram already works well enough.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing real numbers, past the 2,000 users, and proof from another venue near me that the app brought people through the door who didn't come from Instagram.
